evaluations.rationale: Selected. Round 1 supplied directly observed wire evidence and the incumbent's next step is the minimal containment repair at the two known resolution sites with a full replay. No generated candidate had executed evidence, so the incumbent remained strongest under the evidence-weighted rubric.

Deferred, but it is the selected implementation shape: post-resolution origin comparison plus literal rebuild, applied at both sites, with the same-origin double slash and dot-segment behavior as explicit falsifiers.
Deferred. The dot-anchored re-resolution is a distinct alternative, but its literal behavior for a same-origin double slash is less clear and it adds a second parsing step; kept as a comparison idea.
Deferred. Constructor rejection is defense in depth but changes the public contract for same-origin double-slash paths and treats the symptom after resolution; not the minimal repair.
Deferred to the later regression round. The byte-level benign differential is the right instrument once a patched copy exists, but at selection time there was nothing patched to compare.
